mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run (run_id, agent_id, session_id, user_message, status, final_summary, error_message, cancel_reason, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{runId}, #{agentId}, #{sessionId}, #{userMessage}, #{status}, #{finalSummary}, #{errorMessage}, #{cancelReason}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status}, final_summary = #{finalSummary}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE run_id = #{runId}

UPDATE agent_run SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, end_time = COALESCE(end_time, #{updateTime}), update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status IN ('INIT', 'RUNNING')
